title: ACES 5.0 Parts Fitment — shape schema
description: Auto Care ACES 5.0 conformant structural shape for the parts_fitment Iceberg product. Encodes element names and structural relationships ONLY. Does NOT encode licensed Auto Care VCdb VehicleConfigurationID value ranges, Qdb QualifierID ranges, or PCdb PartTerminologyID ranges — those are subscription-based licensed property (Auto Care Technology License Agreement, rev. 2025-02-28). Every synthetic identifier in seed data lives in a DMS-prefixed namespace (DMS-VCFG-*, DMS-QT-*, DMS-PT-*). The qualifier_hash column is a SHA-256 of the qualifier text, not a Qdb QualifierID. Source: Auto Care Association ACES 5.0 standard (released 2026-04-02); shape derived from publicly available documentation. Verified: 2026-08-27.

part_number.description: Manufacturer part number (ACES 5.0 PartNumber element). FK to parts_catalog.part_number.

brand_aaia_id.description: Brand identifier — opaque varchar. Must match the brand_aaia_id on the corresponding parts_catalog row. In this repo always a DMS-BR-* synthetic value; never a real Auto Care Brand Table BrandAAIAID (licensed). Shape enforced by this schema; value-space enforced by lint_no_licensed_autocare_ids.py.

vehicle_config_id.description: Vehicle configuration identifier — opaque varchar. In this repo always a DMS-VCFG-* synthetic value; never a real Auto Care VCdb VehicleID or VehicleConfigurationID (licensed). The VCFG record captures Year/Make/Model/SubModel/EngineBase at minimum. Shape enforced by this schema; value-space enforced by lint_no_licensed_autocare_ids.py.

vehicle_year.description: Model year of the vehicle configuration (ACES 5.0 Year element). Denormalised for query convenience.

vehicle_make.description: Vehicle make (ACES 5.0 Make element). Denormalised; source of truth is the DMS-VCFG-* record.

vehicle_submodel.description: Vehicle sub-model (ACES 5.0 SubModel element). Null when not applicable.

engine_base_id.description: Engine base identifier — opaque varchar. In this repo always a DMS-ENG-* synthetic value or null. Never a real Auto Care VCdb EngineBaseID (licensed). Shape enforced by this schema (when non-null); value-space enforced by lint_no_licensed_autocare_ids.py.

position_id.description: Installation position identifier (ACES 5.0 Position element, e.g., 'Front', 'Rear', 'Left Front'). Forms part of the composite PK with part_number, vehicle_config_id, and qualifier_hash.

qualifier_hash.description: SHA-256 (lower-hex) of the concatenated qualifier text. Used as the PK component instead of a Qdb QualifierID (licensed). Empty qualifier set hashes to the SHA-256 of an empty string (e256ba39a13e2e9c22d...).

qualifiers.description: ACES 5.0 Qualifier elements — zero or more conditions that further restrict the fitment (e.g., 'with Turbo', 'FWD only'). The qualifier_hash is computed over the sorted qualifier text values.

qualifier_id.description: Qualifier identifier — opaque varchar. In this repo always a DMS-QT-* synthetic value if set; never a real Auto Care Qdb QualifierID (licensed). Shape enforced by this schema (when non-null); value-space enforced by lint_no_licensed_autocare_ids.py.

qualifier_text.description: Human-readable qualifier condition (e.g., 'with Turbo', 'FWD only', 'DOHC'). This is the canonical form used to compute qualifier_hash.

quantity.description: Quantity of this part required for the application (ACES 5.0 Qty element).

notes.description: Free-form fitment note (ACES 5.0 Note element). Null when not applicable.

part_type_id.description: Part type identifier — opaque varchar. In this repo always a DMS-PT-* synthetic value or null; never a real Auto Care PCdb PartTerminologyID (licensed). Shape enforced by this schema (when non-null); value-space enforced by lint_no_licensed_autocare_ids.py.

mfr_label.description: Manufacturer label text (ACES 5.0 MfrLabel element). Null when not present.

action.description: ACES 5.0 Action attribute: 'A' = Add/active, 'D' = Delete/superseded. Default 'A' for all active fitment records.

access_channel.description: REPAIR Act forward-readiness dimension (ADP spec Decision 3, 2026-08-27). v1 seeds and enables 'franchise' only. The 'independent' value is a schema placeholder for aftermarket data-access surfaces; no independent-aftermarket persona, API, or seed corpus exists in v1.

tenant_id.description: Catalog partition column per DMS T1.5 invariant. DMS seeds 'dms-reference'; CVX Zone 2 rows use 'cvx-zone2'.
